summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-10 reverse share split of its common shares, effective May 21, 2026. The split reduces outstanding shares from approximately 10,190,337 to 1,019,033, with fractional shares rounded up. No change to authorized share capital. The split aims to regain Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price compliance, as approved by the board on March 18, 2026. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. CUSIP changes to 185053600; proportional adjustments to warrants/options.
